resources.string: Full source dimensions, linear-light processing. Tripod required: Live ND intentionally smooths motion and Composite builds light trails. Keep capture running for at least two completed frames; processing the first source can take time. Originals and a recoverable disk checkpoint are retained. Disk use can be large; output is an independent JPEG, not RAW.
Captures and verifies each saved original before the next request. This reliable source sequence is limited by exposure and processing time, not a promised sensor burst rate.
Astro requires a steady tripod and an available gyroscope. Hold still and try again. Qualification cannot detect subject motion.

Capture a continuous 6–15 frame burst. Distinct subpixel samples enable 2× reconstruction; a steadier burst gives an aligned detail stack at the selected working resolution. Unalignable scenes retain the best valid frame. Only the final result is kept. Full source processing requires sufficient memory. RAW processing takes longer. Rendering engines apply only in Pro mode.
Requested reconstruction needs approximately %1$d MiB; only %2$d MiB is available. Original photos are retained. Choose a smaller camera capture size and retry.
Detail input: full source · native or verified 2× reconstruction
